name: sensative-odoo
description: Look things up in Sensative's Odoo, and change them when you allow it.
long_description:
Gives Claude access to Odoo through your own API key: everything it reads or changes is done as you, with your access rights, and shows up under your name in Odoo's logs.

It starts out read-only. Switch *Read-only* off in the extension's settings when you want Claude to be able to create, update or delete records.

api_key.title: Odoo API key
api_key.description: Your personal key. Create it in Odoo: your avatar (top right) → My Preferences → Security → Add API Key.

odoo_url.title: Odoo address
odoo_url.description: The address you open Odoo at in the browser.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: While on, Claude can look things up in Odoo but cannot create, change or delete anything.
